owner_equipment_step_up.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Forward step-up: whole foot on platform, controlled ascent/descent; existing cw135, not a new duplicate.

owner_equipment_step_variations.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Step-up/lunge variations, including lateral movement context; not evidence for an isolated heel-tap with support-leg-only return or a calf raise.

owner_equipment_step_glutes.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Eccentric Step Down With Body Weight Only: slowly lower left leg, tap heel, relax and transfer weight to floor, then step back onto bench to reset and repeat. Publication describes a 10–12 inches bench, not a measured owner step height. Also step-up/knee-lift context for cw135/cw136.
owner_equipment_step_glutes.editorialAdaptation: Editorial adaptation for cw414: a stable low adjustable step replaces the published 10–12 inches bench; 10–15 cm is illustrative only, not measured owner height or a source-prescribed target. Preserve the controlled descent, floor weight transfer and separate step-up reset; do not turn it into a support-leg-only heel-tap return.

owner_equipment_step_pushup.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Elevated-hand push-up on step in beginner circuit; incline push-up, not feet-elevated cw009.

owner_equipment_feet_pushup.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Decline Push-ups: hands on ground, feet on bench; distinct from hands-elevated incline push-ups.
owner_equipment_feet_pushup.editorialAdaptation: Editorial equipment options for cw009: stable Step or chair in place of the demonstrated bench; no fixed height prescription. These options are adaptations, not an exact list quoted from this article.

owner_equipment_feet_pushup_low.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Decline push-up instructions explicitly allow a low support for the feet; not a mandatory 30–50 cm height.
owner_equipment_feet_pushup_low.editorialAdaptation: Low support is source-supported; exact owner step height is not measured. Stability and control determine a suitable low setting, not a universal centimetre target.

owner_equipment_standing_calf.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Bodyweight Standing Calf Raise: forefeet on raised step, heel lowering and raising, hand support for balance and optional dumbbell. Not a step-up or lunge.
owner_equipment_standing_calf.editorialAdaptation: Editorial equipment naming for cw165: Step or suitable stable legacy bench. Optional balance support and optional dumbbell are separate technique choices, not a requirement for a dumbbell pair or mandatory use of extra weight.

owner_equipment_decline_crunch.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Incline/decline abdominal crunch: secured legs, spinal flexion, distinct from full hip-flexion sit-up.

owner_equipment_decline_situp.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Decline sit-up: secured legs, trunk and hip flexion; unloaded conservative adaptation, no mandatory plate.

owner_equipment_decline_press.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Dumbbell decline bench press setup and controlled press; purpose-rated load-bearing bench required.

owner_equipment_balance.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Two-leg and one-leg standing balance on Dynair cushion only; no pelvic-floor, treatment or clinical claims imported.

owner_equipment_roll_glute.verifiedSections: 2026-10-22 supplied publisher research: Glute foam-roller position and controlled rolling, gentle self-selected pressure; no recovery guarantee.

ownerEquipmentContext.Sandbag: Adjustable but owner operationally keeps 20 kg. Context only, never a universal starting load or progression target.
ownerEquipmentContext.Pasy do zwisu za nogi: Inversion leg straps, not TRX or arm slings; no added inversion movements.
